rows.evidence_summary: The pre-event Q2 2023 Form 10-Q states that Geron's future success depended solely on imetelstat, calls imetelstat its sole/only product candidate, and states that Geron did not currently have any other products or product candidates. Discovery work on possible next-generation telomerase inhibitors had not produced a separate product candidate and therefore does not create a second meaningful active therapeutic asset under the frozen single-asset definition.

promotion_boundary: Single-asset status alone does not freeze or promote this event. Historical universe, timestamp, financing, point-in-time evidence, concentration and registry checks remain mandatory.
